build: Electronic Arts disk release, two double-sided disks as four G64 side images; play copies made with the game's own Copy utility

exclude: 6 parts: Map 29, Map 43, Map 49 and others
6 parts: Map 9, Desert Nomads, Map 10 and others
extra: tile set 1, unpacked from T35/L12 by enter_map ($2722) with map 8
elsewhere: 6 parts: Map 29, Map 43, Map 49 and others
6 parts: Map 9, Desert Nomads, Map 10 and others

comments.text: Tile 0 of tile set 1: blank (all bitmap bytes zero), as in every set. No tile layer of this set's maps holds it; map 29 draws it off its edge (record byte $33 = 0). Tile set 1 serves maps 8 (its text has 'Leaving Nomads.'), 9 ('Entering the Agricultural Station general store.'), 10 ('Leaving Highpool.'), 29, 43 and 49 ('Leaving the Savage Village.'), all on side 1.

Tiles 1-6, the figures every set shares: 1 a grey and white robot-like humanoid, 2 a hulking red and orange one-eyed figure, 3 a yellow and green running figure, 4 a man in a cyan shirt, 5 a tied sack, 6 a brown horned creature. No layer of set 1's maps holds them. Computed from each encounter square's record, the encounter scan (game $95FA: $5BF5 + monster byte 6) would draw 6 on 4 squares of map 9, 1 of map 10, 18 of map 29, 12 of map 43 and 5 of map 49, and 4 on 1 of map 9, 1 of map 10 and 9 of map 49; tile 5 shows on the loot-bag squares, 3 on map 9 and 3 on map 49.

Tile 7, the green-shirted party figure (game $AF1D-$AF25 draws it on the party's square). Set 1's maps also place it as a standing person: 12 squares of their tile layers (map 8: 4, two of them on the train at (7, 2) and (20, 2); map 9: 1, (18, 18), a class-4 square that shows tile 70 instead; 10: 1; 43: 5; 49: 1), and map 8's class-4 square (14, 8) shows it too. The self-modified operand of draw_tile's LDA at $2367 points here because tile 7 was drawn last.

Tile 8, the yellow radiation sign that draw_square puts on class-9 squares from 18:00 to 05:59 ($0B80-$0B8A). No map of set 1 has a class-9 square or the tile in its layer, so as these maps load it is not drawn with this set.

Tile 9 of set 1: a purple peak over light blue and blue bars, the picture sets 1-5, 7 and 8 share (sets 0 and 6 have another). The game draws it on the squares of the player's other parties on the same map (game $AD13-$AD49); none of set 1's tile layers holds it.

Tiles 10-15 of set 1: 10 a blonde figure in purple behind a brown counter (map 9 at (26, 13), map 10 at (30, 24)); 11 a small white hut under a brown roof (13 squares of map 10, the huts at x 9-14); 12 blank, unused; 13 and 14 the left and right halves of a purple slab with a dark grey rim (map 10, at (29, 16)-(30, 16) and (26, 29)-(27, 29)); 15 an orange block shaded brown at its right and bottom (map 10 once, map 29 three times at (27, 12-14)).

Tiles 16-22 of set 1: 16 and 22 blue cubes drawn in perspective (16 in no layer, but the tile of map 43's class-4 record 5 ($3D44), which (30, 27) becomes once the cube 36 there is opened and the loot bag it turns into (loot record 2) emptied; 22 fills a block of 30 class-2 squares at x 27-30, y 1-9 of map 29); 17 a light blue wheel between white rails, edged brown, the four couplings of the train on row 2 of map 8; 18-21 orange blocks with brown edges, the train's wagons on map 8 (19: 6, 20: 11, 21: 1 squares) and blocks on maps 29 and 49 (18: 1 on 29; 19: 1 on 29, 3 on 49; 20: 7 on 49; 21: 2 on 29, 4 on 49).

Tiles 23-26 of set 1: 23 a corner of grey rock with red specks on black (55 squares: map 29: 6, 43: 34, 49: 15; map 43's class-4 square (18, 22) shows it too); 24-26 the top, middle and bottom of a slatted brown and dark grey column with white posts, standing twice on map 9 at (11, 8-10) and (19, 20-22).

Tiles 27-34 of set 1: 27-30 and 34 solid green ground cut by grey diagonal edges, the outlines of the green octagonal patches on map 8 (27: 3, 28: 7, 29: 6, 30: 6, 34: 7 squares, all class 11); 31 and 33 grey rock with black gaps (map 29: 12 and 16); 32 a cyan panel in a white frame with a small black mark, set into walls (16 squares: map 9: 6, 10: 1, 29: 2, 43: 1, 49: 6; 13 of them class 2).
Tiles 35 and 36 of set 1: 35 a white sack with black markings, unused by the maps; 36 a blue cube like 22, on one class-2 square each of map 43 (30, 27) and map 49 (3, 12).

Tiles 37-45 of set 1: 37 a green tree on a brown trunk (map 9: 17, map 10: 23 squares); 38 grey and white rubble (map 9 at (21, 5)); 39 and 40 corners of grey rock (33 and 22 squares on maps 29, 43 and 49); 41 an orange triangle over red and black specks, a diagonal edge on map 9 at (18, 16), (19, 17), (20, 18); 42 and 45 blue water with white ripples (map 10's stream and pond, 2 and 8 squares; 45 also once on map 49); 43 a green mound over dark grey, unused; 44 a diagonal edge of grey rock (25 squares).

Tiles 46-56 of set 1, grey rock with black gaps and cracks: the rock walls of maps 29 and 43 and the outer walls of maps 10 and 49. 46: 89, 47: 103, 48: 79, 49: 60, 50: 550 (370 of them on map 29; 50 is also map 43's off-map tile), 51: 83, 52: 58, 56: 13 squares, nearly all class 11; 53-55 grey and white rubble (13, 45 and 14 squares; three of 54 and one of 55 are class 4).

Tiles 57-60 of set 1: 57 rows of red dashes on black (map 49 at (16, 26) and (16, 27)); 58 black with a few red dots, the floor of every map of the set but 9 (1552 squares: map 8: 243, 10: 702, 29: 317, 43: 122, 49: 168) and the off-map tile of maps 10 and 49; 59 and 60 edges of grey rock (39 and 32 squares on maps 29, 43 and 49; map 43's class-4 square (21, 22) shows 60).
Tiles 61 and 62 of set 1: 61 grey and white streaks, the stone walls of map 9 (196 squares) and of map 49 (42); 62 red bricks in dark grey mortar (51 squares of map 49's walls). All class 11.

Tiles 63-66, the green rows, bushes and trees of map 9, all on class-1 squares: 63 rows of green dots (13 squares, a column at x 3, y 17-29), 64 green stripes (26, columns at x 5 and 7), 65 four small light green bushes (52), 66 a broad green tree on a brown trunk (46, 36 of them in ranks at x 3-19, y 3-6, the north of the map).

Tiles 67-72 of set 1, open ground of dashes on black: 67 green (283 squares: map 8: 155, 49: 128), 68 dense red (map 8: 4, 49: 49), 69 dense green (map 49: 35), 70 red (1541 squares: map 8: 331, 9: 621, 10: 45, 29: 2, 43: 393, 49: 149; the off-map tile of maps 8 and 9 and the tile of three class-4 squares), 71 sparse green (map 8: 182, 49: 125); 72 blank, unused.

Tiles 73-75 of set 1: 73 red and white stripes across red-speckled ground, the two squares (15, 28) and (16, 28) in the gap of map 49's southern wall; 74 white bars beside a light blue and dark grey checked strip running north-south and 75 a light blue and dark grey checked band between white edges running east-west, both unused by the maps.
Tiles 76-79 of set 1, the shores of map 10's stream and pond: blue water with white ripples meeting red-speckled ground along a diagonal (76: 7, 77: 6, 78: 2, 79: 2 squares).
Tiles 80-83 of set 1, white triangles that fill half a square along a diagonal: the four corners of the white octagon on map 9 (three squares each, around x 11-16, y 20-25).
Tiles 84-88 of set 1, purple lines on black inside map 9's white octagon: 84 a purple lattice (8 squares), 85-88 the four quarters of a ring around a small box, at (13, 22)-(14, 23).
Tile 89 of set 1, brown sleepers between two white rails: the railway of map 8, 32 squares: row 2 at x 0-4, 8 and 30-31, around the wagons, and row 4 at x 5-28.

Tiles 90-95 of set 1: 90 red bricks in dark grey mortar like 62 (274 squares: map 10: 61, 29: 77, 49: 136; also the tile of map 49's class-4 square (0, 5)); solid fills 91 green (22 squares in map 8's green patches), 92 blue (9 squares of map 10's pond and stream), 93 white (every pixel pair 11; 8 squares of map 9's octagon), 94 orange (colour 8; 3 squares along map 9's orange diagonal); 95 blank, unused.

Colour bytes of tiles 0-9 in set 1, one a cell (high nibble: pixel pairs 01, low: pairs 10): tiles 0-8 as in every set ($26, $CF, $28, $57, $39/$36, $B7/$BC, $98, $59, $76), then tile 9's $46, $46, $E6, $E6 (purple and light blue over blue).

Colour bytes of tiles 10-26 in set 1: $47 over $49 for the counter figure 10 (purple, yellow, brown); $96, $98, $95 for the hut 11; $46 over $4B for 13 and $4B throughout 14, the purple slab; $86, $89, $88 and $8F (orange with blue, brown, orange or light grey) for the orange blocks 15 and 18-21; $E6 for the blue cubes 16 and 22; $E9 for the coupling 17; $CB with one $26 cell for the rock corner 23; $B9 (dark grey, brown) for the column 24-26, with $29 in 26's top right cell.

Colour bytes of tiles 27-45 in set 1: $5B, $56, $C5 and $25 (green with dark grey or grey; no pixel takes the red of $25 or the blue of $56) for the grass pieces 27-30 and 34; $CB (grey, dark grey) for the rock tiles, some with a $C6 or $26 cell; $36 (cyan, blue) for the panel 32; $CF for the rubble 38; $E6 for the water 42 and 45 and the cube 36; $5B, $56, $59 for the tree 37; $28, $58, $26 for the diagonal 41.

Colour bytes of tiles 46-60 in set 1: $CB (grey for pairs 01, dark grey for 10) throughout the rock, with $C2 in 53's bottom left cell, $C6 in 56's top right and $26 in 60's top left; $26 for the floor tiles 57 and 58.

Colour bytes of tiles 61-72 in set 1: $CB for the stone wall 61 and $2B (red, dark grey) for the bricks 62; $56 for the green rows 63 and stripes 64, $5D (green, light green) for the bushes 65, $56 over $59 for the tree 66; $56 for the green speckles 67, 69 and 71, $27 (red, yellow) for 68, $22 over $2B for 70, $26 for the blank 72.

Colour bytes of tiles 73-88 in set 1: $12 over $B2 (white, red, dark grey) for the striped bar 73; $BE (dark grey, light blue) for the checked barriers 74-75; $26, with a $56 cell in 76 and 79, for the shores 76-79 (blue water as pairs 10); $26 for the white corners 80-83; $44 (purple) for the lattice 84 and $46 for the emblem 85-88.

Colour bytes of tiles 89-95 in set 1: $9B (brown sleepers, dark grey) for the track 89; $2B for the bricks 90; $56 for the solid green 91 (all pairs 01), $26 for the solid blue 92 (all pairs 10), the white 93 and the blank 95; $86 for 94, whose pixels are all pairs 01, orange.
